bleachmod.story.sub_01.name: A Hollow nearby
bleachmod.story.sub_01.desc: Accept the mission and meet Rukia in Karakura.
bleachmod.story.sub_01.dialogue_0: Rukia: I am Rukia Kuchiki, a Shinigami. We guide souls and protect the living from Hollows, spirits that have lost their hearts and attack other souls. A dangerous Hollow is nearby. Face it, then return to me when you have won.
bleachmod.story.sub_01.dialogue_1: Rukia: Defeat the Hollow, then come back and speak with me.
bleachmod.story.sub_01.dialogue_2: Rukia: You won. From now on, you will act as a temporary Shinigami. There is still much to learn and more missions ahead. Take this Asauchi to continue your journey.
bleachmod.story.sub_01.encounter_lost: Fishbone died without validating your victory. Retry from the Mission Journal or speak with Rukia.

bleachmod.story.sub_02.epilogue: The conflict between Orihime and her brother reaches its resolution.
bleachmod.story.sub_03.epilogue: Shrieker’s pursuit ends, and the story of the parakeet’s soul is revealed.
bleachmod.story.sub_04.epilogue: The school incident ends. Kon remains part of the story.
bleachmod.story.sub_05.epilogue: Grand Fisher retreats. Don Kanonji’s hospital incident provides the next context.
bleachmod.story.sub_06b.epilogue: The Menos retreats. The crisis draws Soul Society’s attention.
bleachmod.story.sub_07.epilogue: Renji is defeated, but Byakuya takes Rukia to Soul Society. Her rescue is still ahead.
bleachmod.story.ss_01.epilogue: Jidanbō acknowledges your victory. Gin blocks entry; Yoruichi points towards Kūkaku.
bleachmod.story.ss_ganju_01.epilogue: Ganju ends the challenge and remains alive. Kūkaku’s preparation is available.
bleachmod.story.ss_06.epilogue: Renji remains alive. Seireitei reacts to Aizen’s apparent death.
bleachmod.story.ss_09.epilogue: Byakuya prevents the release for now. Yoruichi advises preparation; Rukia remains imprisoned.
bleachmod.story.ss_10.epilogue: Mayuri retreats following your victory. The final preparation is available.
bleachmod.story.ss_front_01.epilogue: Soi Fon remains alive. Yamamoto’s conflict with Shunsui and Ukitake remains narrative context.
bleachmod.story.ss_12.epilogue: Rukia is freed and entrusted to Renji. Byakuya’s opposition remains.
bleachmod.story.ss_13.epilogue: Byakuya acknowledges your victory. Aizen’s conspiracy is revealed; he leaves with the Hōgyoku. The execution is cancelled and Rukia stays in Soul Society. Return voluntarily through an available route.
